683:t_030:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
(Big Sis... I couldn't tell you my final words...)

683:t_030:5.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
(Big Sis... I couldn't tell you my final words...)

683:t_030:6.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
(Big Sis... I couldn't tell you my final words...)

683:t_030:7.en:
$$ノノ$$
(But $$ノノ$$ will fight...! With the hard work and guts $$ノリコ$$ and Big Sis taught her...!)

683:t_030:8.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
(But $$ノノ$$ will fight...! With the hard work and guts $$ノリコ$$ and Big Sis taught her...!)

683:t_030:9.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
(But $$ノノ$$ will fight...! With the hard work and guts $$ノリコ$$ and Big Sis taught her...!)

683:t_031:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This is bad! Reports say the surrounding fronts are collapsing one after another, and $$宇宙怪獣$$ are pouring into this area!」

683:t_031:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「More reinforcements are coming in this situation?!」

683:t_031:2.en:
$$レド$$
「At this rate, before we defeat that $$変動重力源$$, $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3 will...!」

683:t_032:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「Is that a force coming from another direction?!」

683:t_032:1.en:
$n
「This is bad! At this rate, $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3 will...!」

683:t_033:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「She protected $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3 with her own body?!」

683:t_033:5.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「But even $$ダイバスター$$ can't keep taking those attacks...!」

683:t_033:6.en:
$$ノノ$$
「It's all right... $$ノノ$$... was born to do this...」

683:t_033:7.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「It's all right... $$ノノ$$... was born to do this...」

683:t_033:8.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「It's all right... $$ノノ$$... was born to do this...」

683:t_034:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「$$ディスヌフ$$! Is that you, Princess?!」

683:t_034:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「...You saved me by bringing me all this way.」

683:t_034:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Thank you. I'll... make use of your life.」

683:t_035:0.en:
$$チコ$$
「$$ディスヌフ$$ absorbed the $$バスター軍団$$'s degeneracy reactor!」

683:t_035:1.en:
$$カシオ$$
「Now that it has regained the degeneracy reactor removed millennia ago and opened the true cockpit hidden in its artificial brain, $$ディスヌフ$$ reveals its true form!」

683:t_035:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Let's do this, $$ディスヌフ$$!!」

683:t_036:1.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Is that $$ディスヌフ$$'s true form?!」

683:t_037:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「This... is $$バスターマシン１９号$$!!」

683:t_039:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「It's stupid to be grateful for pain and suffering!」

683:t_039:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You're always like this! Even when it costs you, you always give it everything and charge straight ahead...!」

683:t_039:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「But that's what being human means!」

683:t_039:9.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Strength isn't the size of your body! It's the power of your heart! Isn't that right, $$ノノ$$?! That's... hard work and guts!!」

683:t_040:3.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Yes, Big Sis!」

683:t_041:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Of course it is! It's $$ノノ$$ and Big Sis's $$イナズマキック$$ of friendship!」

683:t_041:2.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Of course it is! It's $$ノノ$$ and Big Sis's $$イナズマキック$$ of friendship!」

683:t_041:3.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Of course it is! It's $$ノノ$$ and Big Sis's $$イナズマキック$$ of friendship!」

683:t_041:4.en:
$$カズミ$$
「That $$トップ部隊$$ combat uniform looks good on you, $$ラルク$$...」

683:t_041:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Th-This was just in $$ディスヌフ$$'s cockpit...」

683:t_041:6.en:
$$カズミ$$
「You've inherited the $$トップ部隊$$'s spirit along with that uniform.」

683:t_041:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Through your hard work and guts.」

683:t_041:9.en:
$$ラルク$$
「It has a nice ring to it.」

683:t_041:13.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Each of you alone is just a flame...」

683:t_041:14.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But put two together, and they become a blaze!」

683:t_041:15.en:
$$ラルク$$
「When we become a blaze, we...」

683:t_041:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And that doesn't apply only to you two!」
